About Bored Bandit

Bored Bandit gathers concerts, parties, markets, classes, trivia nights, sports and community events from across the San Antonio area, from downtown and the Pearl to New Braunfels, Schertz and Helotes, and puts them in one place. New events are added every day.

Pick a date, choose how far you’re willing to drive, and see what’s happening near you. Star the ones you like to find them again, or add Bored Bandit to your phone’s home screen. Hosting something? Submit your event and we’ll add it.
